Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate the “seconds” part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Series Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on MIAX for the current session. The product ID sent in this message is what will be disseminated in Top of Market BBO and Last Sale messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on MIAX system today.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted Option value

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: “Y” = Far month expiration, “N” = Near month expiration (as defined by MIAX rules)

Field.Name: Active on MIAX
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on MIAX in the current session

Field.Name: MIAX BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by MIAX

Field.Name: Liquidity Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Quote/Order acceptance as per MIAX rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market:

Field.Name: Priority Quote Width
Field.Description: Maximum allowable width for a quote for this Option during regular trading in order to be considered as Priority Quote. 0 when Priority Quote Width is not applicable.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify the firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to each Underlying group. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: ToM Version
Field.Description: Eg: ToM01.01

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned ID for the current trading session

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current system status

Message.Name: Last Sale Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate Trades that are resulting from executions on MIAX during the current trading session.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the timestamp

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique Trade ID assigned to every Trade.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. 0 for New trades. Greater than or equal to 0 for trades resulting from corrections/adjustments.

Field.Name: Reference Trade ID
Field.Description: 0 (zero) if new trade. Trade ID of the original trade if this trade originated as a correction of the original trade.

Field.Name: Reference Correction Number
Field.Description: Correction Number of the trade that was just corrected/adjusted. 0 for new trades.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Price at which this product traded

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts executed in this trade

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition Value

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate canceled Trades that are resulting from Trade cancellations or corrections on MIAX during the current trading session

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds part of the timestamp

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Trade ID of the Canceled Trade

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number of the trade being canceled. 0 for New trades being canceled. >=0 if this is cancel of a trade that resulted from corrections/adjustments.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Trade price of the Canceled Trade

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Trade volume of the Canceled Trade

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade condition of the Canceled Trade

Message.Name: Liquidity Seeking Event Notification Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate information each time a Liquidity seeking event (defined in Event Type field below) starts at MIAX.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which this notification was generated by MIAX system.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: MIAX Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Type of Event

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: When Event Type is “O”: always 0. When Event Type is “L” or “R”: Unique Event ID for the current event.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Current price of the Event. Usage: Please refer to Appendix D for details.

Field.Name: Imbalance Side
Field.Description: This is the side of the excess liquidity that is waiting to get matched. When Event Type is “O”: Imbalance Side. When Event Type is “R”: Side that will be routed. When Event Type is “L”: Side of oversized order initiating liquidity refresh.

Field.Name: Quantity 1
Field.Description: When Event Type is “O”, “L” or “R”: MatchQty - Number of contracts ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present). Other Event Types: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Quantity 2
Field.Description: When Event Type is “O”, “L” or “R”: Routable Quantity. Number of contracts that may be routed. Other Event Types: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Quantity 3
Field.Description: When Event Type is “O”, “L” or “R”: Imbalance Quantity. Number of contracts on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched. Other Event Types: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Quantity 4
Field.Description: When Event Type is “O”, “L” or “R”: Must Fill Quantity. Number of contracts, on the provided Side, that must be matched at the provided Price. These contracts are crossing the provided Price and MIAX is seeking liquidity for these contracts. Other Event Types: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Value.Description: Miax Will Accept Position Closing Orders Only

Value.Description: Miax Will Accept Open And Close Positions
